title: 汇丰Joey Chu：印尼盾20,000关口还有多远？
speaker: Joey Chu

segments.en: Well, 20,000 is a little bit far away for a dollar IDR.
segments.zh: 嗯，美元兑印尼盾到两万还比较远。

segments.en: I think we're thinking more like breaking your to date highs first, and then thinking about the next round figure, like 83, 84, 85, right?
segments.zh: 我认为我们更多考虑先突破年内高点，然后再考虑下一个整数关口，比如83、84、85，对吧？

segments.en: But look for IDR, the recent announcement by MSCI is definitely very difficult to digest, because the implications for the flows, if it really does happen, this double downgrade next year, could be quite large, right?
segments.zh: 但看印尼盾，MSCI最近的消息确实很难消化，因为如果明年真的发生这种双重降级，对资金流动的影响可能相当大，对吧？

segments.en: So we are already coming in to, we're already coming from a year, a year to date, nine months, the last nine months of outflows and reserves run down, draw down, so it could be really quite difficult to digest, but this is still a risk for now.
segments.zh: 所以我们已经在进入，我们已经经历了今年迄今九个月的资金流出和储备下降，所以可能真的很难消化，但目前这仍是一个风险。

segments.en: I don't think investors are actively trying to pull money out, so recently since the MSCI announcement, the equity outflows have happened, but they are not super large.
segments.zh: 我不认为市场参与者在积极撤资，所以最近自MSCI宣布以来，权益资产有流出，但规模不是特别大。

segments.en: Some of the outflows already did happen in the first half of the year, so positioning is still a little bit more on the light side, and people are waiting to see more MSCI news before they commit to further outflows.
segments.zh: 部分流出已在今年上半年发生，所以仓位仍偏轻，人们在等待更多MSCI消息后再决定进一步流出。
